'''Ziko''' was a small company that produced [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinoculars]] and other similar devices. The company manufactured the [[1000 Field Macrobinoculars]], the [[1020/A]], and the [[1125 Heads-Up Macrobinoculars]].<ref name="ROE" />
